name: Shelly 3EM-63T Gen3
summary: Compact 3-phase (or 3x single-phase) 63A energy meter with integrated pass-through CTs, mounts on breakers.

extra.mounting: clips above/below DIN-rail MCBs; conductor passes through Ø8mm integrated CT

gotchas: Powered from 220-240VAC between LA and N only — will not run on a US 120V leg; for US split-phase use Shelly Pro EM-50 or Pro 3EM
Integrated CTs only accept conductors ≤Ø8mm and ≤63A (saturates at 130A) — not for US 100-200A service mains
Designed to clip onto European DIN-rail breakers; US plug-on panels have no rail
Metering only — no relay/contactor output (see Shelly EM Gen3 or Pro EM-50)
No Ethernet; Wi-Fi in a steel panel may be weak (see Shelly Pro 3EM with LAN)
best_for: EU-style 230/400V 3-phase subpanels or three 230V branch circuits
